localisation.GENERIC_light_industry_investments_desc: Injecting capital into civilian industries as well as the oil complex can help our economy come forward in the toughest of times.
localisation.GENERIC_heavy_industry_investments_desc: Injecting capital into the military-industrial complex will make equipment yields higher, making sure all of our troops are well-equipped for battle.
localisation.GENERIC_refitting_the_military_industry_: We can open new factories in order to make sure our equipment production doesn't fall back.
localisation.GENERIC_combined_military_defense_indust: Through our excellent work and effort, we are now able to more efficiently run our defense industries.
localisation.GENERIC_naval_reform_desc: It's about time we get rid of our outdated naval practices and begin taking the water forces more seriously.
localisation.GENERIC_naval_bases_desc: The construction of docks and harbors all over the coasts will not only benefit the industry, but our navy, too.
localisation.GENERIC_submarines_desc: We may begin looking into submarine technology, to prevent any invaders from getting uncomfortably close to our above-water ships.
localisation.GENERIC_surface_ships_desc: The brute force behind any maritime operation, investigating the most effective and modern surface ships will directly lead us toward naval supremacy.
localisation.GENERIC_dockyards_desc: Building more harbors and stimulating the naval industry is needed for us to thrive in commerce and combat!
localisation.GENERIC_nuclear_submarines_desc: A nuclear submarine is any type of submarine powered by a nuclear reactor. They are more powerful, faster, and rarely need to refuel.
localisation.GENERIC_naval_doctrine_innovations_desc: We may study standard factional doctrine of some of the most powerful military world orders to become more effective in maritime combat ourselves.
localisation.GENERIC_light_helicopter_operators_desc: A helicopter carrier is an aircraft carrier that is mainly used to carry helicopters, but it is also often classified as an amphibious assault ship or an anti-submarine aircraft carrier. It is mainly used for military aviation missions including anti-submarine warfare, amphibious operations, and close air support.
localisation.GENERIC_aircraft_carriers_desc: An aircraft carrier is a warship that serves as a seagoing airbase, equipped with a full-length flight deck and facilities for carrying, arming, deploying, and recovering aircraft.
localisation.GENERIC_naval_doctrine_expertise_desc: Integrating every element of modern naval doctrine into a combined set of tactics will make even the greatest maritime powers tremble with our prowess.
localisation.GENERIC_vessel_production_desc: It might be possible to generate an uptick in naval production rates by optimizing dockyard paperwork and promoting naval culture in coastal states.
localisation.GENERIC_air_force_reform_desc: Under the principle that a nation controlling its skies is a nation controlling its lands, we must pursue modernization in all doctrines regarding the air.
localisation.GENERIC_fighter_planes_desc: Fighter or pursuit aircraft are designed with air-to-air engagement in mind. They are the primary way for our air force to obtain aerial superiority over any battle space.
localisation.GENERIC_military_industry_investment_pro: Major investment projects in our defense industry will expand our capacity to produce military equipment and strengthen our industrial base.
localisation.GENERIC_large_ship_drydocks_desc: Constructing specialized drydocks capable of building and maintaining large warships, including carriers and amphibious assault ships, will enhance our naval shipbuilding capabilities.
localisation.GENERIC_improved_repair_facilities_desc: Modernizing our naval repair facilities will reduce maintenance downtime and keep our fleet operational and combat-ready at all times.
localisation.GENERIC_composite_industrial_expansion_d: Expanding our composite materials industry will provide advanced materials for aerospace, naval, and armored vehicle production.
localisation.GENERIC_weapon_conversion_packages_desc: Developing modular weapon conversion packages will allow us to quickly upgrade and adapt our existing military systems to new threats and technologies.
localisation.GENERIC_convoy_and_freighter_production_: Expanding production of merchant vessels and convoy escorts will secure our maritime trade routes and protect vital supply lines in wartime.
localisation.GENERIC_establish_a_marine_corps_desc: Creating a dedicated marine force specialized in amphibious operations will give us the capability to project power from the sea and conduct complex landing operations.
localisation.GENERIC_submarine_expansion_project_desc: Expanding our submarine fleet with modern vessels will strengthen our undersea warfare capabilities and provide a powerful deterrent to potential adversaries.
localisation.GENERIC_stealth_ships_desc: Developing stealth naval technology will reduce our ships' radar signatures and provide a critical tactical advantage in modern naval warfare.
